reviews.text: The team was extremely attentive, and Dr. Debora was exceptional!

They provide very caring service! A family-run clinic, highly respected in the region. Excellent professionals. My puppy has already had several surgeries there, always with great attention. I highly recommend them.

We rescued a cat of approximately 3 years old, put him in a carrier, and went to the clinic to have the necessary exams done and take him home. We were seen by Dr. Fernanda, who demonstrated TOTAL unpreparedness for rescued cats. She left the carrier door open, he escaped, we were in a room that had a piece of furniture with space underneath, he hid there, and she didn't know what to do, even more so than my husband and I. My husband was lying on the floor for 30 minutes, and I was holding the carrier to put him back in.
We left without exams and without the necessary care.
We brought the kitten home and will look for another option because Dr. Fernanda has no experience in caring for rescued animals.
The professionals know how to handle cats, something that many clinics aren't capable of, especially here in São Paulo!

Excellent clinic, highly humanized treatment, very attentive staff, exceptional human beings.
Fair prices, I only have praise and gratitude, the oncologist Dr. Carolina is wonderful.
Congratulations to all.

Excellent veterinary clinic, I've been a client for over 20 years. Receptionist Célia is very attentive and polite. The WhatsApp service is excellent, the attendant is also very attentive. I've been treating two cats since October 30, 2025. Cherry unfortunately passed away; she was 18 years old. Now I'm treating Tom. I have no complaints about Dr. Débora, Dr. Joel, and Dr. Paulo. Dr. Cíntia was unprofessional and is not the person I will seek to treat my animals next time. I don't want to be treated by her for any procedure with my animals.

In my opinion, the best clinic in São Paulo. I've been taking my pets there for years and they're always well treated. I recommend the clinic to everyone who wants real care for their animals. They don't focus on money, but on the animal's well-being. 1000 out of 1000!!
Good service, friendly and caring towards our furry children.

First of all, I want to thank Dr. Débora and the entire clinic team for their treatment and dedication.
From the receptionists, assistants, vets responsible for the exams, etc… they gave me security and made me feel welcomed and at peace leaving Lola in your care.
The surgery was a success, and both the operation and the post-operative period were monitored with seriousness and care.
Gratitude 🙏
Luciana and Lola
All the professionals are extremely attentive and empathetic. Great service and fair prices.
My dog ​​underwent leg surgery and died post-operatively from breathing problems. I find the case very strange. I felt the professionals were unprepared and unfriendly.

This is my second terrible experience with Dr. Adriana, and I doubt she's even a doctor. She almost suffocated my cat to death while drawing blood. Her conduct is awful, she has no manners, no sensitivity whatsoever, and is a miserable person. The clinic is great, the price is fair, the location is good, and Dr. Debora is fantastic, but this Adriana is a disgrace. She shouldn't even be working in this field; she should work in a place isolated from everything, from people and especially from animals (they don't speak and can't express their pain). Dr. Adriana is cruel, unprofessional—everything we don't need when our animals have needs. Don't go to this woman, avoid her.

Dr. Débora, you need to have more love for your profession and for animals. My dog ​​had surgery at this place, and their recovery is horrible. My dog ​​still cries in pain to this day. This doctor, being a doctor, should treat people with more love and respect. It seems like we're asking you for a favor.
A wonderful clinic, Dr. Joel, who treated my dog, is fantastic, so kind, so caring with the dog, explained everything perfectly, an exceptional doctor... I highly recommend him....

I received excellent service from the moment I arrived at reception. Dr. Débora was very helpful and attentive. Unfortunately, my cat passed away, but everything was done for him. I highly recommend the clinic and the entire team, from the doctor to the cleaning staff. Excellent.

I've been going to this clinic for a long time, I've brought several animals there, including a cat with sporotrichosis. He was very well treated. I loved Dr. Patrícia Sampaio. And now I'm receiving excellent care from the didactic Julia …
